Interface ModelInterface

All Known Implementing Classes:
Game
public interface ModelInterface
Minimal abstraction of the game model exposed to the controller layer. Implemented by Game.

Keeping the controller dependent on this interface rather than directly on Game makes it possible to replace the model with a test double during unit testing.
